findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Facility was found not to be in compliance with the food protection manager certification. Discussed with PIC, who showed inspector the email with ServSafe customer service regarding the certification. Upon the completion of the food protection manager course, there were some mix ups with the employee name in the system and facility has been working with ServSafe to resolve the issue. Facility also has another employee that is in the process of getting certify as well. The examination to get certified is expected to be completed in the coming weeks. Ensure that there is a certified food protection manager at the facility during all operational hours.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Inspector observed the ice machine drop guard to be soiled with mold. This is a repeat violation from the last routine inspection. Develop a habit of regularly evaluating the ice machine drop guard and maintaining it free of mold and accumulated soil. The ice machine drop guard is being cleaned during the inspection. 
Inspector also noted the coffee filter basket areas of the coffee machines are soiled. They were cleaned and sanitized during the inspection. The violation is considered corrected on site. Make sure to regularly evaluate the ice tea maker filter basket as well.

(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-201.11: Inspector observed a bottle of cleaner stored on a shelf holding food items and plastic wrap. There are also several boxes of soap stored on this shelf as well. Maintain cleaners and food related/food contact items separated. The cleaner and the soap were moved to a lower shelf. The violation is considered corrected on site.   

(A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The facility has a chest freezer in the kitchen and a sandwich freezer in the lobby with accumulated frost build up. Defrost and clean these two units and maintain them clean for the next routine inspection. 


NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
6-202.14: The inspector observed the door to the women’s rest room to have a broken self closing device. Provide a working self closer to the door and maintain it operational for the next routine inspection. 

Toilet rooms located on PREMISES shall be completely enclosed and provided with tight fitting and self-closing door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11:  Inspector observed an area of the wall in the kitchen to the right of the 3 part sink to have ripped dry wall. Wall is absorbent in this area. Paint or seal the wall in this area so that it is smooth and easily cleanable.
Also, The trim of the door to the women’s rest room is broken and missing across the top of the door where the self closer was previously attached.  Repair/seal the area so that it is smooth and easily cleanable. 

(A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The floor to the left of the working ice machine is soiled. Clean and maintain clean. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Inspector observed a food handling employee to wash hands properly but then turn off the faucet without the use of a clean barrier. Employee was coached immediately and rewashed hands using proper procedure. Take every opportunity to train hand washing. The violation is  COS.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Inspector observed the drop guard of the ice machine in back to be soiled. The ice was not up to the drop guard so the guard was cleaned and sanitized with a sanitizing solution. COS

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

Cheese and cheese with sausage stick items are observed in the walk in cooler between 47F and 51F. The thermometer inside of the unit is reading 50F The items were voluntarily removed from the walk in cooler an placed in a cart to be inventoried and discarded. The milk items in the cooler are ultra pasteurized refrigerate after opening milk products. Have management call and let the inspector know if this cooler is needed for TCS (temperature control for safety) foods or if the items are going to be stored in a different cooler.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. 

The facility has a walk in cooler labeled cold drinks that was holding some cheese items which require refrigeration. The unit is holding at between 47F and 50F. Discuss if this walk in cooler is needed to hold the TCS food items or of the items will be moved to a different cooler. It appears that there are 6 different coolers that, if holding at 41F or below, could be used for the cheese. Currently these cooler are holding soft drinks.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

A few boxes of single service items are observed on the floor in the back storage area. Store single use item properly protected.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Inspector observed every chest freezers in the facility along with one small glass front cooler to have accumulated frost in them. Defrost the freezers and maintain them cleanable.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:

Observed ice scoop to be sitting on top of ice machine in the back. Ensure ice scoop is placed on a surface that can be easily washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Discussed with PIC. COS.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

Observed the hot dogs and torpedo’s in the refrigerator to lack date marking. PIC could tell Inspector when items were pulled. Date was placed on items. Ensure date marking and disposition of expired foods - no longer than 7 days. COS.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements. 

(REPEAT) Observed the bleach being utilized not for use on food-contact surfaces. Laundry and cleaning bleach is being used. Discussed with PIC. PIC indicated she could not find food-contact surface type bleach. Inspector will follow-up on 3/14/21. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 7/21/21.

findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed both women’s and men’s bathrooms to lack caulking at the hand sinks. Ensure caulking before next routine inspection. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection son 6/4/21 and 7/21/21.

Observed the 3 compartment sink in the back prep area to lack caulking. Ensure caulking before next routine inspection. This is as repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 7/21/21.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.  

Observed no vomit/diarrhea policy for facility. Facility has misplaced handout provided by SCDPH. Inspector was out of the policy handout during inspection. Inspector will provide a copy upon return on 8/2/21.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

Observed food handling employee to wash hands properly; however, did not use a barrier to turn off the faucet. Discussed with employee. Ensure use of a barrier to turn off faucets in order to hinder cross contamination (such as a paper towel). COS.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:

(C) A self-closing, slow-closing, or metered faucet shall provide at least 15 seconds of flowing water. (D) An automatic sink shall be installed to manufacturer’s guidelines. 

Observed both women’s and men’s customer bathrooms to lack hot water. Inspector waited for 5-10 minutes and neither sink gained hot water - just cold. Repair by 8/2/21. Inspector will follow-up.
